name: queryMedicalRecord
shortDescription: Retrieves a patient's medical record or specific parts of it, ensuring authorized access.
description:
Overview

This function retrieves a patient's medical record or specific sections thereof, ensuring that only authorized users (the patient themselves, their assigned doctor, or an administrator) can access the information.

Intended use

Called by the patient or doctor UI to view medical history. Parameters include patientId, and optional filters like recordType or a dateRange.

Logic

  1. Validate patientId and ensure the calling user has appropriate permissions (e.g., is the patient, an assigned doctor, or an admin).
  2. Query the MedicalRecord entity using ctx.data.query, filtering by patientId and any additional criteria like recordType or recordDate range.
  3. Optionally, retrieve associated Patient and Doctor information using ctx.data.get.
  4. Return the list of matching MedicalRecord entries.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • Patient
  • Doctor
